**T06 stage-two contract recheck: FAIL. Blocking 1, should_fix 1.** Both independent focused runs passed **83/83** tests, comprising 69 metrics and 14 team tests. The source-CLI probes matched **145/150** expectations. Five mismatches reproduce the two findings below. This was a fresh Codex context with the same OpenAI provider. [Results and counts](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/summary.json)

### Findings

1. **Blocking · T-4 · `finish` accepts a team row with no visible summary or no usable evidence-link label.** In an otherwise canonical `PROJECT-CLOSE.md`, set the summary to `[](details.md)`, `[ ](details.md)`, or a single U+200B. `node bin/pace.ts project finish P001` returned `0` in each synthetic repo, where the contract requires `1`. A fixed evidence link labeled only `<!-- note -->` also returned `0`. The validator checks the raw strings, and the rendered cells contain an empty anchor, whitespace, or a zero-width character. Plain text and a labeled Markdown link passed. [Validator](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:56) · [Summary fixture](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/new-controls/empty-link-summary/input-close.md:23) · [Exit output](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/new-controls/empty-link-summary/finish-result.json) · [Evidence-link fixture](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/new-controls/comment-in-link-label/input-close.md:23) · [Rendered evidence](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/new-markdown-render.txt:77)
2. **Should fix · T-4 · An inline comment in an otherwise visible table header passes.** Adding `<!-- note -->` after the first header label returned `0`, although the documented table format excludes inline comments. The row remains readable and its evidence link works, so this is a format enforcement issue. [Contract](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/docs/TEAM-METRICS.md:37) · [Header check](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-retrospective.ts:45) · [Fixture](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/new-controls/comment-in-header/input-close.md:21) · [Exit output](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/new-controls/comment-in-header/finish-result.json)

### Alignment and verified scope

**Upper-goal alignment holds.** BR01 defines request reach, BR09 supplies the ledger, BR06 turns those records into comparable measurements, and BR07 consumes the retrospective evidence. The documented column-zero headings, block boundaries, and canonical three-column table are sufficient for P009 P-5. The blocker occurs inside that supported format. [P009 goals](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/PROJECT.md:25) · [T06 criteria](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/TASK.md:26)

| Scope | Independent result |
|---|---|
| **Achieved · T-1/T-2 measurement and input boundaries** | Strict Team stats kept an unproven `by:user` answer plus a failed attempt unconfirmed. It retained one failed attempt and kept both `reachedTotal` and comparison `owner_questions` null. The raw legacy report retained `failed_only`. A matching typed answer receipt established reach. Array-valued `requestId`, `t`, and `ts` returned stats exit `2` and finish exit `1`. Valid service IDs and local SHA-256 receipts passed, and malformed path receipts failed. Legacy FIFO stayed at six seconds. The BR09 ledger showed two delegations, two results, one close, and one open delegation that `finish` warned about. [Request controls](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/new-controls.json) · [Type and receipt controls](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/previous-delta.json) · [Legacy FIFO](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/legacy-fifo-replay.json) · [Ledger](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/ledger.json) |
| **Achieved · T-3 comparison and R18 grade parsing** | Actual stats-derived snapshots preserved `[1,1]` and `[0,2]` in comparison JSON and returned `unknown` despite equal sums. Different and mixed collection origins also returned `unknown`, with specific follow-up plans. Uniform quality and the same origin retained improvement and worsening controls. Adjacent grade punctuation passed while decimals, exponents, and duplicate grades were rejected. Comparison-purpose separation and T01 adapter controls passed, and all three T01 files matched their `HEAD` SHA-256. [Comparison and grade controls](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/new-controls.json) · [Comparison implementation](/Volumes/Data/AiStudio/workspace/pace.wt/P009/src/project/team-comparison.ts:99) · [T01 hashes](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/t01-sha256.log) |
| **Achieved · T-5/S-7 source-CLI observation** | `project start P001 --role maker --agent codex --no-launch` created the synthetic worktree used for stats JSON and text, snapshot comparison, `stats --write`, retrospective, and `finish`. The start event recorded `teamMetricsVersion:1` and `runtimeObserved:false`. After marker removal, missing retrospective evidence held `finish` at exit `1`, and the valid retrospective passed with exit `0`. Role work time remained null. [Start event](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/role/role-start-event.json) · [Worktree command log](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/role-commands.jsonl) |
| **Unmet · T-4 and T06 acceptance** | The earlier wider-table variants, nested headings, escaped-pipe false headers, lazy continuations, and HTML/comment/entity-only summaries held. Canonical and blank-separated tables passed. The visible-summary and evidence-link finding still blocks T-4. T06 and T07 obligations remain. [Replayed boundaries](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/replay-current-contract.json) · [Wider-table controls](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/previous-delta.json) |
| **Unknown · PM checks and T08 field outcomes** | The full suite and broad native OS lock regressions remain PM scope. Behavior dependent on the denied `ps` observation is unknown. Live model loading, adoption and efficacy in both real repositories, and a real skill retrospective remain pending user validation after main merge and installation. [Project scope](/tmp/pace-t06-stage2-new.RCdB3N/PROJECT.md:32) |

I ran `node --test test/team-metrics.test.ts test/team.test.ts` under Node `v24.22.3`, with the second run retaining the fixtures. The probe scripts use `node "$d/<probe>.mjs" "$PWD" "$d/<fixture>"` and record actual `bin/pace.ts` arguments, cwd, output, and exit codes. I retained the first attempts and corrected replay assumptions for indented headings, additional follow-up plans, the `finish` diagnostic, and the start event required to measure FIFO. The candidate passed `git apply --reverse --check`, and all test writes were confined to temporary paths.
